evidence: Heavily Al-doped ZnO thin ﬁlms were deposited on the c-Al2O3 substrate at a temperature as low as 180 /C14 C by ALD using alternating pulses of Zn(C 2H5)2 (Diethylzinc, DEZn), Al(CH3)3 (Trimethylaluminum, TMA) and H 2O vapor in an N2 carrier gas ﬂow. The ALD process consisted of two kinds of cycles; cycle I contained the following sequence: DEZn, 0:01 s ! N2 purge, 5 s ! H2O, 0:1 s ! N2 purge, 5 s for the growth of ZnO, and cycle II contained TMA, 0:03 s ! N2 purge, 5 s ! H2O, 0:1 s ! N2 purge, 5 s for the doping of Al.
